parent_objective: design a bounded no-rollout materialization preflight for comparison-support candidates
blocked_by: M2116 candidate audit must admit materialization preflight design before implementation
supersedes: direct measured execution from generated candidates
direct profile ranking from candidate rows

public_gates: M2117 must freeze candidate-to-executable-spec mapping before implementation
M2117 must preserve M2115 claim guards in planned artifacts
M2117 must define reset-free validation checks for materialized artifacts
M2117 must not run reset rollout measured execution or rank controller families
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not treat generated rows as paper-valid tasks

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: freezes the reset-free materialization preflight protocol for the audited candidate panel
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: materialization design only; no reset validity rollout driver performance ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if materialization requires profile-specific tuning
stop if materialization would drop candidate intent or claim-guard metadata
stop if design cannot define reset-free validation checks
stop if design routes directly to ranking
fallback_plan: route to materialization preflight implementation if design is bounded and claim-safe
route to design repair if candidate-to-spec mapping is underspecified
route to branch synthesis if materialization collapses to the previously failed public-gate panel
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2116 audits the generated comparison-support candidate artifact as clean

admission_evidence: M2116 audited four intent groups of 60
blocked_shortcuts: do not run reset or rollout
do not treat candidate rows as paper-valid tasks
allowed_updates: M2117 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for materialization preflight implementation

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2117 designs materialization and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2117.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2115 candidate artifact and M2116 audit.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If materialization design cannot preserve claim guards, repair design before implementation.
allowed_claims: no reset validity, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: moves the new support-targeted candidate panel toward executable artifact preflight without repairing fixed public rows
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can prepare a materialized support-seeking panel but cannot make a paper verdict by itself
must_synthesize_if: M2117 cannot specify materialization without dropping candidate metadata
M2117 routes directly to measured comparison

hypothesis: A bounded materialization preflight can be designed to convert M2115 candidates into executable specs and workload rows while preserving claim guards and without running the environment.
success_criteria: no reset rollout measured execution ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: planned artifacts drop claim guards or candidate intent
new reset or rollout is performed
ranking or paper-level claims are made

commands.name: design

decision_rule: M2117 passes if it freezes a bounded reset-free materialization preflight design with claim-safe metadata preservation.
